description: This file is a React component for the RCA (Root Cause Analysis) page in the manufacturing defect management system's frontend. It manages state, handles form inputs for initiating root cause analysis, loads a queue of defect items requiring analysis, and submits RCA data to an API.

methods.name: loadQueue
methods.description: Fetches the RCA queue from the API and updates component state.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission to submit root cause analysis data to the backend.
